title: 第21章 名望提升第22章 启程前的准备
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第21章名望提升
行道中途，镇长在分岔路口将人质们按居住地划分出来，并分配了骑士团的骑士一路护送，并不忌讳众人在场，写了一封信件让一名骑士骑马去最近的大城市。
新约镇不是一个大城市，牢房有限，而人贩的数量太多，必须转送至其他城市关押。
如此雷霆迅速的处理事情，倒是让辛西倍感意外。
“唐，这个镇长是个好镇长呢。”辛西走到唐的身后与他小声说道。
“新约镇有这样一位镇长，其实是很幸运的。”唐回答。
姆莉默默动笔记下这段对话，随后将目光放到了一旁撒欢的两只猎犬身上。
一只是小黑，另一只是白色的猎犬，都是欧吉桑先生驯养的猎犬。
骑士团过来的速度很快，考虑到他们有骑马，姆莉大致计算了一下速度，推测出曼波是在他们出城后立即汇报了这件事情。
姆莉将这件事告诉唐，可唐却不以为然道：“我早知道他会这么做。”
“那你为什么还要……有些多此一举了。”姆莉怪异地看着唐。
“不对，姆莉。”唐摇头，“如果前面没人行动，我想骑士团是不会这么迅速的。”
唐太了解骑士团了，他们就是这个德行。
不过他还是希望骑士团可以再晚些到来，否则他不确定能否如此顺利救出人质立下大功一件，最关键的是……将那个可能有损他名誉的【信物】交还给原主。
这次，姆莉三人成功跟着骑士团进入了镇长的城堡，并亲眼看着欧吉桑先生被骑士请过来接受赏赐。
“欧吉桑，念你此次训犬立功，不仅救出了上百人质，还抓住了百位恶徒，我将给予你应得的奖励。”镇长从头到尾没提一件私事，随后大手一挥，让仆人们将早已准备好的三袋钱财放到大厅上。
“这里是你之前驯养的猎犬被恶徒利用所上缴的钱财，经我再三思虑后，我决定将它们归还于你。
“这一袋银币是立功之赏赐，依亚里罗王国律法按功劳等级给的奖赏，你且收下。
“最后一袋是我私人的犒赏。”
当镇长说完，欧吉桑纳头便拜道：“感谢镇长大人赏赐，感谢男爵大人赏赐！”
镇长做手势让欧吉桑起身先行离开，欧吉桑会意，领了自己的奖赏又刻意站到了唐的面前，向唐投去了感激的目光。
唐轻笑着摇头，什么都没说，欧吉桑也郑重点了下脑袋，随后离开了城堡。
“还有我忠诚的骑士，曼波。”
镇长看向列队的骑士，随后曼波便郑重的走到了大厅中间，单膝跪向镇长，做了个非常标准的主臣骑士礼。
“从今天起，你擢升小队长一职，俸禄翻倍，另奖赏你一袋银币。”
“男爵大人的恩德，曼波万分感激！”
镇长点头，招手示意仆人送来一袋比刚刚小上许多的钱袋。
曼波收下奖赏，在镇长的示意下归队。不过在这之前，他也向唐投去了感激的目光。
唐轻轻点头，保持着沉默。
“最后，唐……”镇长语气忽然一泄，不满又无奈地看了唐一眼，“你上来吧。”
“好的，男爵大人。”唐从两位同伴之间走出，来到大厅中央，正要向镇长行骑士礼，却被镇长拦住了。
content_en:
Chapter 21 Increased reputation
Halfway through the journey, the mayor divided the hostages according to their residence at the fork in the road, and assigned knights of the Knights Order to escort them all the way. He did not shy away from the presence of everyone, and wrote a letter asking a knight to ride to the nearest big city.
New Testament Town is not a big city, and there are limited cells. However, the number of human traffickers is so large that they must be transferred to other cities for detention.
Cinxi was surprised by Lei Lei's quick handling of the matter.
"Tang, this mayor is a good mayor." Xinxi walked up behind Tang and whispered to him.
"New Testament Town is actually very lucky to have such a mayor." Tang replied.
Muli silently jotted down this conversation, and then turned her attention to the two hounds having fun on the side.
One is a small black dog, and the other is a white hound. They are both hounds trained by Mr. Ogisan.
The knights came over very quickly. Considering that they had horses, Muli roughly calculated the speed and deduced that Mambo reported the matter immediately after they left the city.
Mu Li told Tang about this, but Tang disapproved and said: "I knew he would do this."
"Then why are you... it's a bit unnecessary." Muli looked at Tang strangely.
"No, Mli." Tang shook his head, "If no one acted in front, I don't think the knights would be so quick."
Tang knew the Knights too well, they had this kind of virtue.
However, he still hopes that the Knights can arrive later, otherwise he is not sure whether he will be able to successfully rescue the hostages and accomplish a great feat. The most important thing is... to return the [token] that may damage his reputation to its original owner.
This time, the three of them successfully followed the knights into the mayor's castle and watched Mr. Ogisan being invited by the knights to accept the reward.
"Ogissan, in view of your meritorious service in dog training this time, you not only rescued hundreds of hostages, but also captured hundreds of villains. I will give you the reward you deserve." The mayor did not mention a single private matter from beginning to end, and then waved his hand and asked the servants to place the three bags of money they had prepared in the hall.
"Here is the money that was turned over to the hounds that you had trained before and were used by the villains. After thinking about it again and again, I decided to return them to you.
"This bag of silver coins is a reward for meritorious service. It is a reward based on merit levels according to the laws of the Kingdom of Arilo. Please accept it.
"The last bag is my personal reward."
When the mayor finished speaking, Ogisana bowed and said, "Thank you, Lord Mayor, for the reward, and thank you, Lord Baron, for the reward!"
The mayor gestured to Ogisang to get up and leave first. Ogisang understood, received his reward and deliberately stood in front of Tang, casting a grateful look at Tang.
Tang chuckled and shook his head without saying anything. Ogissan also nodded solemnly and left the castle.
"And my loyal knight, Mambo."
The mayor looked at the knights lined up, and then Mambo solemnly walked to the middle of the hall, knelt down on one knee and made a very standard knightly salute to the mayor.
"From today on, you will be promoted to squad leader, your salary will be doubled, and you will be rewarded with a bag of silver coins."
"Mambo is extremely grateful for your kindness, Lord Baron!"
The mayor nodded and waved to the servant to deliver a bag of money that was much smaller than before.
Mambo accepted the reward and returned to the team at the mayor's signal. But before that, he also cast a grateful look at Tang.
Tang nodded slightly and remained silent.
"Finally, Tang..." The mayor's tone suddenly dropped, and he glanced at Tang with dissatisfaction and helplessness, "Come up here."
"Okay, Lord Baron." Tang walked out from between the two companions and came to the center of the hall. He was about to salute the mayor as a knight, but was stopped by the mayor.
